cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; a bridal room — holds a small bouquet in both hands at her waist; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her front; a present-day seaside arcade with a glass prize-claw machine filled with folded plush stars — using the claw-machine joystick with a sharpshooter’s patience; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; an indoor climbing wall of coloured holds — kneeling on the ground; a far-future orbital hotel recreation pool under a transparent observation dome — trying the low-gravity relaxation deck after a swim; a walk-in closet with open shelves — pins a freshly washed sheet to the line above her; a starship galley and mess hall — dries her hair with a towel; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — sitting on the ground; a second-hand book stall under an awning on a quiet street — standing; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height
